text: I suppose it’s partly my fault--I should have warned you--but for pity’s sake why couldn’t you have smelled it?” Anne dissolved into tears under this double disgrace. “I couldn’t--I had such a cold!” and with this she fairly fled to the gable chamber, where she cast herself on the bed and wept as one who refuses to be comforted. Presently a light step sounded on the stairs and somebody entered the room. “Oh, Marilla,” sobbed Anne, without looking up, “I’m disgraced forever. I shall never be able to live this down.
